Fourth-Generation Dacia Sandero Stepway Adopts the Latest Design Signature Ahead of Time - in CGI
8 photos
Photo: avarvarii / Instagram
Without a doubt, the French automaker Renault succeeded in its plan to make its Romanian subsidiary a viable entry-level alternative to the established carmakers roaming across the Old Continent.
They took over Automobile Dacia back in late 1999 and immediately started chasing Volkswagen’s Skoda brand, which initially had the same customer targets. But while Dacia remained a smart choice over the years, Skoda has often surpassed the namesake Volkswagen brand in both sales and prices.
Today, Dacia is an innovator in the smart automotive area above all – they have a female CEO, which is still rare even in today’s business climate, and have continuously created success stories with models like the Logan, Sandero, Duster and, most recently, the Bigster. They are on their way toward attacking the compact class with both the Bigster and the new Striker, their biggest models to date.
But, of course, the bread and butter across the Old Continent remains the Dacia Sandero and Sandero Stepway series – the European sales leader in both 2024 and 2025! Just recently, Dacia made strides to retain the crown in 2026 with the introduction of the late-2025 mid-cycle refresh, the second facelift operated across the board.
Also, they just announced that the Old Continent's leading models will become even more enticing as both the Dacia Sandero and its Stepway version go hybrid with 155 ps or 153 hp on tap. They remain highly accessible, with prices in the UK starting from £17,995 (OTR) and £19,295 (OTR), which is about $24k or $26k at the current exchange rate, respectively. And they’re also feisty, hitting 62 mph in 8.3 seconds.
Anyway, the future is coming, and the rumor mill plus the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI are already thinking about the fourth iteration of the Dacia Sandero twins.
More precisely, Andrei Avarvarii, the virtual artist behind Avarvarii Automotive Artworks (also known as ' avarvarii ' on social media), has taken a thorough, in-depth CGI look at Dacia's upcoming plans and came up with this unofficial, hypothetical design project for the next-generation Sandero Stepway as an illustration for Auto Express.
It combines “official manufacturer insights, platform architecture data, and Dacia’s evolving styling cues to preview the upcoming next-generation Dacia Sandero,” according to the author. It’s pretty obvious the pixel master has infused the fake next-gen Sandero Stepway with “a sharper, more futuristic edge (…) taking direct inspiration from the Striker alongside the brand's latest Bigster and Duster models.”
It’s also slightly more rugged, as per the trends, and in their opinion, it will have a “multi-energy platform supporting both full-electric and hybrid-petrol powertrains (so) the design projects a planted, purposeful road presence for Dacia's next chapter.” What do you think – yay or nay? View this post on Instagram A post shared by Avarvarii Automotive Artworks (@avarvarii)
